_note: Small TEACHING database. Add your own entries. min_version is inclusive, fixed_in is exclusive. Always verify against nvd.nist.gov before acting.

vulnerabilities.description: Attackers can tell which usernames exist on the server (username enumeration).
'regreSSHion': a race condition that may allow remote code execution as root.
Path traversal that can expose files outside the web folder and may allow remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.fix: Upgrade Apache httpd to the latest 2.4.x release.

vulnerabilities.description: Buffer overflow in mod_lua that may allow remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.fix: Upgrade Apache httpd to 2.4.52 or newer.

vulnerabilities.description: Off-by-one error in the DNS resolver that can crash nginx or allow code execution.
Backdoored release: a smiley face in the username opens a root shell.
vulnerabilities.fix: Replace vsftpd 2.3.4 with a clean, current version immediately.

vulnerabilities.description: mod_copy lets unauthenticated users copy files on the server (can lead to code execution). Verify your exact patch level.
Buffer overflow in IIS 6.0 WebDAV that allows remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.fix: IIS 6.0 is end-of-life. Move to a supported Windows Server and IIS version.

vulnerabilities.description: This PHP version no longer receives security fixes, so new bugs will never be patched.
vulnerabilities.fix: Upgrade to a supported PHP version (see php.net/supported-versions).
